label: technical documentation
definition: Documentation kept up-to-date by providers of general-purpose AI models containing training/testing processes, evaluation results, and information from Annex XI for submission to authorities.
source_quote: draw up and keep up-to-date the technical documentation of the model, including its training and testing process and the results of its evaluation

label: information and documentation to providers of AI systems
definition: Documentation made available to providers of AI systems integrating the model, enabling understanding of capabilities/limitations and compliance with obligations, while protecting IP rights.
source_quote: draw up, keep up-to-date and make available information and documentation to providers of AI systems who intend to integrate the general-purpose AI model into their AI systems

label: policy to comply with Union law on copyright
definition: A policy put in place by providers to comply with Union copyright law, including identifying and complying with reservations of rights expressed under Directive (EU) 2019/790.
source_quote: put in place a policy to comply with Union law on copyright and related rights, and in particular to identify and comply with, including through state-of-the-art technologies, a reservation of rights

label: summary about the content used for training
definition: A sufficiently detailed summary made publicly available by providers describing the content used to train the general-purpose AI model, following an AI Office template.
source_quote: draw up and make publicly available a sufficiently detailed summary about the content used for training of the general-purpose AI model

label: cooperate as necessary with the Commission and national competent authorities
definition: The duty of providers to cooperate with the Commission and national competent authorities in exercising their competences and powers under the Regulation.
source_quote: Providers of general-purpose AI models shall cooperate as necessary with the Commission and the national competent authorities in the exercise of their competences and powers pursuant to this Regulation

label: rely on codes of practice to demonstrate compliance
definition: The ability of providers to use approved codes of practice (Art. 56) to demonstrate compliance with obligations until harmonised standards are published.
source_quote: Providers of general-purpose AI models may rely on codes of practice within the meaning of Article 56 to demonstrate compliance with the obligations set out in paragraph 1 of this Article

label: demonstrate alternative adequate means of compliance
definition: The duty of providers who do not adhere to codes of practice or harmonised standards to demonstrate alternative adequate means of compliance for assessment by the Commission.
source_quote: Providers of general-purpose AI models who do not adhere to an approved code of practice or do not comply with a European harmonised standard shall demonstrate alternative adequate means of compliance for assessment by the Commission
